coverage: 2000-present: structured Governor archive from 2020, plus 36 weather emergency orders added by hand: 7 Bush orders from 2000-2003 read one at a time from the State Library order archive (edocs.dos.fl.gov), which disallows crawlers and is not crawled; Bush and Crist orders from 2004-2010 catalogued with their dates by the FSU College of Law collection on Florida Government Documents; and 2005-2019 declarations dated from the order copies kept by FMCSA, the Division of Emergency Management and DEP, archived Governor pages, the Florida State Agricultural Response Team's Hurricane Dennis newsletter, and news coverage. No state declaration was found for DR-1381 (Tropical Storm Allison, 2001) or DR-4138 (July 2013 flooding). EM-3259 (Rita, 2005) counts as matched only because its incident period runs into the Wilma declaration, and DR-1481 (June to August 2003 flooding) only because the August 2003 Palm Beach County tornado order falls inside its incident period; 27 saved records kept that this refresh's check of the state source did not return
